items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; conditional for bounded internal evidence work and ordinary reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, data-handling, and platform-policy boundaries. Exact decision: keep searchwoot.com private, keep Woot permission outreach unsent, and do not expand alerts, monetization, tracking, deployment, or public exposure. Evidence: Woot documentation confirms API access but not redistribution, storage, derivatives, public display, caching, alerts, affiliate, advertising, image, trademark, price, freshness, correction, or takedown rights; Woot terms restrict commercial/public data use. All four launch-readiness tasks remain open. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 37 pass, 16 fail, 6 unknown, with banner, consent, GA4, privacy, and terms findings. Analytics is yellow because source permissions or collector errors remain. Revenue is partial aggregate: $4.92 commission for 2026-09-21 cannot be assigned to a site. Human counsel is required before any rights-dependent request, beta, launch, affiliate use, advertising use, or material privacy decision. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only bundle covering field-level rights, deployed data flow and retention, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence.

Launch-readiness progress: 0 of 4 tasks closed; 4 remain open. Existing evidence is attached for official Woot API, terms, support documentation, repository/configuration artifacts, privacy and cookie-policy artifacts, and draft terms. No task closes because rights, field-level provenance, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification, GA4 settings, vendor coverage, incident procedures, accuracy/freshness, and rollback evidence remain incomplete. Continue the active workstream without changing launch state or creating duplicate requests.
